issues.description: RL is called the third branch.
issues.qualification: A pedagogical comparison, not a universal exhaustive taxonomy.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Critic feedback is described as scarce and delayed.
issues.qualification: This is common, not necessary; the lecture later uses dense per-step rewards.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Off-policy learning works regardless of exploration strategy.
issues.qualification: Its target can differ from the behavior policy, but learning guarantees still need adequate state-action coverage and other assumptions.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Discounting is motivated by a hard time limit.
issues.qualification: Discounted infinite-horizon return is well defined for bounded rewards and 0≤gamma<1; a hard cutoff is not required.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Optimal wording may suggest guaranteed return.
issues.qualification: Values optimize expected cumulative return; individual stochastic outcomes can differ and actions can tie.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.qualification: Q-based exploitation chooses greatest estimated cumulative return, which need not maximize immediate reward.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Model-based learning requires perfect prior knowledge and no exploration.
issues.qualification: The slide contrasts known-model planning with model-free learning; model-based methods can instead learn models and need exploration.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Target is labeled actually happened and convergence is attributed only to decaying learning rate.
issues.qualification: The reward and transition are sampled but next Q is estimated. Classical guarantees require finite/tabular assumptions, sufficient visits and suitable step sizes; fixed alpha in the example does not establish that theorem.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.qualification: A genuine terminal successor has no continuing return; an external time-limit truncation of a continuing task is different.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Any arbitrary target and subsequent grasping are suggested.
issues.qualification: Targets must be reachable under task constraints. FetchReach trains reaching, not object grasping.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Dense reward is called always negative and fourth action is described as gripper control.
issues.qualification: Negative distance is zero at exact coincidence. FetchReach blocks the fourth gripper command; its inclusion in the API does not make it effective.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: register_envs is described as loading all robot models.
issues.qualification: In tested Gymnasium 1.4.0 it is a compatibility no-op; importing gymnasium_robotics registers environments, and make constructs the selected environment.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: The action example implies a unit command is a physical displacement.
issues.qualification: Actions are normalized controls; achieved movement is governed by the simulator and is not guaranteed one metre or one discretization bin.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: State is described as current position.
issues.qualification: The code bins desired minus achieved goal, clips tails and omits other observation components; this compressed relative state can alias different physical conditions.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.qualification: Termination indicates a task-defined terminal state, not necessarily success. FetchReach is continuing and its default time limit truncates after 50 steps.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Unconditional bootstrap precedes both termination and truncation.
issues.qualification: Appropriate for continuing FetchReach truncation; not a generic true-terminal update with a nonzero next-state estimate.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: One printed stochastic training trace may look guaranteed or monotonic.
issues.qualification: No seed is supplied, and even the displayed checkpoints worsen between episodes 1000 and 1500.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Plot caption/prose implies convergence near zero.
issues.qualification: The displayed curve fluctuates around negative totals and does not prove convergence, zero error or optimality.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved

issues.description: Larger grid, deep RL and gripper extension are suggested as simple changes.
issues.qualification: Update hard-coded bounds/offsets together with shape, account for sample/storage costs, and use an actual grasp-capable task rather than changing an ignored FetchReach channel.
issues.status: preserved with explicit scope; not globally resolved
